name: Kizaru!! Compared to Two Years Ago We're a Hundred Times Stronger Now!!
effect:
[Main] Your [Monkey.D.Luffy] Leader gains [Unblockable] during this turn.
(This card cannot be blocked.)
[Counter] Your Leader gains +3000 power during this battle.

official_faq.question: If a character with [Unblockable] attacks a character, can OP14-060 Donquixote Doflamingo's [On Your Opponent's Attack] effect be used to change the target of the attack to your Leader Donquixote Doflamingo?
official_faq.answer: Yes, it can. Changing the attack's target with an effect is different from using [Blocker] to block.

official_faq.question: If a character with [Unblockable] attacks a character, can OP14-060 Donquixote Doflamingo's [On Your Opponent's Attack] effect or EB01-038 Oh Come My Way's [Counter] effect be used to change the target of the attack to a character with [Blocker]?
official_faq.answer: Yes, it can. Changing the attack's target with an effect is different from using [Blocker] to block.
